install_startup.recipe_modification_note: Gitea's own Dockerfile builds from source, needing bash/git/openssh/sqlite/etc from dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org - used the project's own officially-published Docker Hub image (gitea/gitea) instead. Its own multi-field web install wizard also didn't reliably complete under this pipeline's automated form-filling (9 fields submitted, no progress after 9 attempts) - switched to Gitea's own documented INSTALL_LOCK=true + DB_TYPE=sqlite3 env-var pattern (a standard, officially-supported way to skip the wizard for unattended deploys), landing directly on the real app with open registration enabled.
